n=20
G=[[9]*n for _ in range(n)]
# Cross dividers
for r in range(n): G[r][9]=8
for c in range(10): G[7][c]=8
# Top-left block: bounds rows 0..6, cols 0..8; rings [4,0,2] repeating
seq=[4,0,2]
for r in range(0,7):
    for c in range(0,9):
        d=min(r,6-r,c,8-c)
        G[r][c]=seq[d%len(seq)]
# Bottom-left: bounds rows 8..19, cols 0..8; palette from corner d0=7, d1=2
seq=[7,2]
for r in range(8,20):
    for c in range(0,9):
        d=min(r-8,19-r,c,8-c)
        G[r][c]=seq[d%2]
# right block bounds rows 0..19 cols10..19, palette from corner 9, inward1
seq=[9,1]
for r in range(20):
    for c in range(10,20):
        d=min(r,19-r,c-10,19-c)
        G[r][c]=seq[d%2]
for row in G: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
